title: Lixity — Private Manuscript Studio, Prose Rhythm & Provenance
description: Precise prose cadence, historical research matching, and elegant standalone editions. 100% offline, privacy-first, and local.
eyebrow: Your voice. Your research. Your craft.
headline:
A focused sanctuary for your manuscript.
Precision in rhythm, fidelity in research.
intro: Sense where a chapter breathes or stumbles. Trace every scene detail and historical fact back to its verified source. Curate standalone reading copies with precisely the context your editors or readers need. Lixity unites immersive reading, living research dossiers, and transparent linguistic resonance in a private, local-first studio for authors.
demo_note: Fictional English manuscript. Interactive read-only demo. No account or upload required.
preview: The real workspace: immerse yourself in the prose, then choose when to inspect its underlying architecture.
tasks_title: From initial spark to polished prose.
read_text: Immerse yourself in clean typography, set tactile review markers, and explore sentence cadences in context. The integrated editor pairs focused drafting with local autosave, robust conflict protection, and an uninterrupted undo history—transitioning seamlessly between creation and reflection.
research_text: Anchor manuscript passages directly to primary sources, thematic dossiers, and narrative decisions. Immutable revisions preserve the evidence behind every detail—keeping historical accuracy, geographical cues, and character motives grounded.
share_title: Curated reading editions and print copies.
share_text: Generate beautiful book PDFs, standalone offline companion websites, or focused proof copies for beta readers. No cloud tracking, zero external lock-in: your creative project remains completely yours.
principle: Evidence over interference: the author commands.
principle_text: Lixity offers nuanced linguistic mirrors, never artistic dogma. It does not grade literary merit or rewrite your sentences with automated prose. It gives you the clarity to sculpt your own voice and fulfill your vision on your own terms.
start_text: Install Lixity locally on Windows, macOS or Linux. Start with Markdown or plain text and follow the installation guide.
scope: This website follows the development checkout. Check the published release for available features; optional services have separate data boundaries.
languages_text: Explore this website in seven languages. The app follows the selected analysis profile; CLI report language has its own setting. Technical documentation stays in English.
limits: Analysis resources and validation differ by language; German and English have the broadest coverage. Interface translation does not translate your manuscript.
feedback_text: Tell us what you were trying to write, investigate or share, and where the workflow helped or interrupted you. You do not need to share your manuscript.
linguistics_title: Listen to the pulse and melody of your prose.
linguistics_text: Explore pacing shifts, sentence-length variations, dialogue balance, and sensory cues across chapters. Every statistic links back to its exact words in the text, illuminating narrative arc and voice without opaque generative AI intervention.
language_suggestion: Prefer another language? Use your saved choice or a language supported by your browser.

tour_read: Read first. The manuscript stays centre.
tour_passage: One passage: exact sentences and word counts.
tour_research: Research beside the text: dossiers and claims.
tour_context: Every quotation keeps its source version.

editor_status: Writing in Lixity: the integrated editor is implemented in the development checkout, not yet released. The tour and public demo show the read-only workflow.
workflow: Close reading, evidence and chapter comparisons stay connected to the text. Built-in analysis runs offline; optional speech and research services are configured separately. The CLI and Python API reuse the same analysis engine.
